---

## 🌙 Overnight Oats — Portions by Person

| Ingredient | Diego (2090 kcal, weight loss) | Diana (1600 kcal, weight loss) |
|---|---|---|
| **Rolled oats** | 80 g | 55 g |
| **Coconut milk** (canned, full-fat) | 80 ml | 60 ml |
| **Chia seeds** | 15 g | 10 g |

### Estimated macros per serving

| | Diego | Diana |
|---|---|---|
| **kcal** | ~460 kcal | ~320 kcal |
| **Carbs** | ~58 g | ~40 g |
| **Protein** | ~13 g | ~9 g |
| **Fat** | ~19 g | ~13 g |
| **Fiber** | ~9 g | ~6 g |

---

### 💡 A few tips:
- **Add a protein boost** — a scoop of plain Greek yogurt or a soft-boiled egg on the side would round out Diego's breakfast protein nicely (he needs more to support his weight-loss + training goals).
- **Toppings** — fresh raspberries or blueberries fit perfectly with what you already love and add fiber with minimal calories.
- **Coconut milk** is calorie-dense; if you want a lighter version, swap half for unsweetened almond or oat milk.

## 💧 Liquid Adjustment for Overnight Oats

- **Diego:** Add **40–60 ml more** coconut milk (or water/almond milk if you want to keep calories in check)
- **Diana:** Add **30–40 ml more** coconut milk (same idea)

---

### 💡 Tips for a less pasty result next time:
- **Ratio to aim for:** ~1:2 oats to liquid (so 80g oats → ~160ml liquid for Diego, 55g oats → ~110ml for Diana)
- **Stir well before adding more** — sometimes it just needs a good mix after sitting overnight
- **Thinner but still creamy?** Try half coconut milk, half water — you keep the flavour without the heaviness
- **Chia seeds absorb a lot** — if you reduce chia slightly (e.g. 10g for Diego, 8g for Diana), it'll naturally loosen up too

Good to know! That changes the calorie picture a bit — low-fat coconut drink (like a carton coconut beverage) is much lighter than canned coconut milk, so here's the updated breakdown:

---

## 🥥 Revised Overnight Oats — Low-Fat Coconut Drink

| Ingredient | Diego | Diana |
|---|---|---|
| **Rolled oats** | 80 g | 55 g |
| **Low-fat coconut drink** | 160 ml | 110 ml |
| **Chia seeds** | 15 g | 10 g |

### Updated estimated macros

| | Diego | Diana |
|---|---|---|
| **kcal** | ~390 kcal | ~270 kcal |
| **Carbs** | ~60 g | ~41 g |
| **Protein** | ~12 g | ~8 g |
| **Fat** | ~9 g | ~6 g |
| **Fiber** | ~9 g | ~6 g |

---

### 💡 Things to note:
- Since low-fat coconut drink has **less fat**, it's also **less filling** — a handful of walnuts or almonds on top would help satiety for both
- The **lower calories** actually give a bit of room to add a protein topping like Greek yogurt for Diego especially
- Great news for **Diana's 1600 kcal target** — leaves plenty of room for the rest of the day!
